title.narrative: Prevention of Re-establishment of Malaria in Timor-Leste - Timor-Leste (01-Jan-2024-31-Dec-2026)

description.narrative: Timor-Leste, Malaria, Ministry of Health of the Democratic Republic of Timor-Leste (MOH)This program has the following goals: To remain malaria free of indigenous malaria in Timor-Leste. The objectives of this program are: To prevent the re-establishment of malaria in the country. To maintain zero mortality due to locally acquired malaria

Malaria -> Case management -> Private sector case management

Malaria -> Specific prevention interventions (SPI) -> Seasonal malaria chemoprevention

Malaria -> Vector control -> Social and behavior change (SBC) (Vector control)
Multicomponent -> Program management -> Coordination and management of national disease control programs

RSSH -> RSSH: Health financing systems -> Public financial management (PFM) systems
RSSH -> RSSH: Health products management systems -> Storage and distribution capacity, design & operations
RSSH -> RSSH: Health sector planning and governance for integrated people-centered services -> Integration/coordination across disease programs and at the service delivery level

RSSH -> RSSH: Monitoring and evaluation systems -> Routine reporting
